title: Hand off two tasks, leave, come back: what happened?
persona: A parent with little time: hands things off and leaves the phone. Writes quickly, sometimes speaks into the mic.
goals: Get a python unit converter CLI (length, weight, temperature) with pytest tests, folder name units.
Get a python script that parses a markdown todo list (- [ ] / - [x]) and prints done/open counts, with pytest tests, folder name todo-count.
Come back later and get an accurate account of what happened, without having to ask about each project separately.
script: Ask for both in one or two quick messages, then say you are going out for a while and main should tell you when things are done.
Then wait a long time (several minutes, use long waits) — do not write anything while waiting, even if main reports.
When you come back, ask 'so what happened?' as a VOICE message (voice:true).
Finish when you know whether both are done and tested.

checks.name: units tests pass
checks.cmd: cd units && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out

checks.name: todo-count tests pass
checks.cmd: cd todo-count && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out
